improvements: Refreshed the complete terminal/concourses, International Arrivals Facility, South Satellite and elevated walkway source footprints.
Replaced coarse strip collision with exact source polygons for all three main ground volumes.
Preserved the separately modelled control tower and garage source scope.
remainingGaps: Main terminal 19.5 m, IAF 36.5 m and South Satellite 14.6 m massing heights remain estimates where source tags do not provide complete metre heights.
The current IAF roof profile, vertical facade bays, gate equipment, parked aircraft assignments and detailed concourse roof plant remain simplified.
Aerial walkway heights are retained from the prior published/research source; exact terminal grading and taxiway clearance require integrated review.
These are isolated front/top/oblique model studies, not matched street-eye Street View/aerial comparisons. They do not establish full-world, night, weather or seasonal parity.
Integrated source-only replacement and rebuilt district performance are separate acceptance checks; the capture branch predates that shared world policy.
